clips.title: The story
paras: Following the discovery of an incriminating message signed only by an initial, Lieutenant Doren seeks to identify the traitor within the Rebel Camp. By cross-referencing duty rosters, duty records can reveal who shared patrol routes with Private Thorsen during the previous week.

The recovered note bears only the initial M, which provides little on its own to expose the conspirator aiding the Kurzen forces. However, the author mentions sharing regular duty paths alongside Private Thorsen throughout the previous week. Lieutenant Doren directs you across the Rebel Camp to speak with Corporal Sethman, the soldier responsible for maintaining duty logs, to identify who walked alongside Thorsen.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The note you gave me is signed with an "-M"...I don't know what that could mean.
But...the note also says this person shared patrol routes with Thorsen last week. So whoever shared patrol with Thorsen last week must be the traitor!
Go to Corporal Sethman. He handles the patrol schedules and can tell you who was with Thorsen.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh, yes I can check that for you. Let's see...last week it was...
...why, it was Private Merle scheduled with Thorsen. They had the same patrol times all of last week.
